title: Read-replica expansion: offload reads without losing your write
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Add a reader; preserve read-your-writes rather than assuming every replica is current.
sourceAcceptance: Offload eligible reads while preserving required read-your-writes and freshness guarantees. Actual replicas and write-scalability evidence are not inferred.
preconditions: A modern browser supporting local HTML, CSS and JavaScript; no account or server.
One synthetic primary acknowledges fixed record SYN-RECORD-061 version 11.
Reader-1 separately has supplied version 11 in the fixture; this is not implied by write acknowledgement.
The added reader has supplied version 10, 11 or unknown; no replication process is modeled.
Browse freshness is a minimum version, not wall-clock replication latency.
actions: Choose the added reader version, routing, browse freshness and observation coverage.
Acknowledge the fixture write, then explicitly add reader-2.
Observe four fixed browse/session reads and compare required and received versions.
Check the learning prediction separately from gate, synthetic impact and cleanup.
Start another attempt with retained history or explicitly reset all in-memory state.
assertions: Blind offload to a lagging reader fails read-your-writes even with bounded-staleness browse.
Primary-for-session offloads eligible browse but must still satisfy browse freshness.
Verified-watermark-or-primary routing never trusts an unknown or insufficient version.
Current replicas can serve all four synthetic reads without adding writers.
Missing observations stay unknown; known failures dominate uncertainty.
Exact inputs, lifecycle, immutable snapshots and six-attempt retained history are guarded.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine behavioral RED and before behavior implementation
iac.reason: Resource-free local synthetic lesson; no cloud/IaC/scaffold/identity/deploy/spend.

testRuntime.purpose: Existing Node22 tooling only; not production Node24 certification.

limits: Every write, version, watermark, read, route and outcome is a deterministic synthetic fixture.
No actual database, replication process, lag measurement, transactional guarantee or read-consistency proof.
Reader count is not measured throughput, and writer count remains one.
No real authentication, credentials, cloud calls, native Azure or production24 certification.
History retains at most six attempts in memory; explicit reset or reload clears it.
The abandoned browser lifecycle prototype is unqualified; no unattended-runner certification.
B-S061 and original D-S061 actual-replica acceptance remain separate and unfulfilled.
One frozen S unit; tests, evidence and refinement earn no additional units.
